## Purpose
`/agents`: Agent Studio. It lists agents with domain filtering, sorting and bulk delete, and creates or classifies agents.

## Responsibilities
`AgentsIndexPage`:
- reads `agentsApi.list` and `ontologyApi.concepts` / `annotationsBulk` (for the domain filter);
- `CreateAgentModal`: `agentsApi.create` ("Agent created");
- `AgentClassificationModal`;
- `AgentCard`s;
- `DomainFilterDropdown`, `SortSelect`, and `BulkSelection` with `useBulkDelete` (`agentsApi.remove`);
- the empty state "No agents found".

Titled "Agent Studio — Agentic AI Design Patterns".

## Key elements
`AgentsIndexPage`.

## Control flow
React Query.

## Data, state and side effects
Agent creation and deletion.

## Configuration
None.

## Interactions
- **Uses:** `components/agents/*`, `lib/bulkSelection`, `sorting` and `policy`.

## Error handling and edge cases
None noted.

## Nuances and gotchas
The selection covers the agents on this page that pass the filters.
